chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: John Kirby's arrangements and his own old music
summary: His six-piece band used Kirby's Opus One and Dawn on the Desert arrangements and Raymond Scott's, still in his files.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, the Kirby band played around Chicago.

Yeah, Kirby, and then -- see, I had a combination, well, six pieces, like he did. And we just took the tenor player and let him play the clarinet part, and then the alto. And Kirby gave us a lot of opus, 'Opus One' and all of that thing.
'Dawn on the Desert,' all of those things.
Raymond Scott, right, right. But he gave me some of those arrangements.
Do you still have that stuff?
Yeah, I think I've still got some over to my ex-wife's house. I got a whole batch of music from that era.
Right. And I have never really gone through it. But I'm sure I can find some of those Kirby arrangements and all that stuff.
Right, right, right, because it's just like they did them.
